        - **Design architecture (Verification toolchain layout, Reference DUT hierarchy (Module 0), First simulation artifact flow):** Walk through the block diagram, then relate each block to files under module0/examples/.

- **Syllabus:** Cover 12 topic section(s) — pause on protocol timing and signals.
